title: Drift Wood #33 · the map
logline: Chloe got in. Wood draws her a map of a city he's never seen.

panels.composition: The newsroom. A thick envelope, opened, on CHLOE's desk. Seattle. She is not looking at it. WOOD is.

characters.pose: typing, not looking at the envelope

image.prompt: a school newsroom, a thick opened envelope on a desk beside a teenage girl typing who won't look at it, a boy in an overcoat staring at the envelope

panels.composition: Wood, already drawing on the back of a proof.

characters.pose: drawing fast on the back of a proof

balloons.text: Neither had the people who named the streets.

image.prompt: a teenage boy drawing rapidly on the back of a newspaper proof sheet while a girl watches skeptically

panels.composition: The map: a city invented from nothing, hills, water, a needle-shaped tower drawn from a postcard, and, in the middle, a small X labeled in his hand: YOU. Off the edge, an arrow: ME, 250 MI.
props: a hand-drawn imaginary map of Seattle

image.prompt: close-up of a hand-drawn imaginary city map on the back of a proof sheet: hills, water, a needle-shaped tower, an X in the middle and an arrow pointing off the page
image.notes: Labels YOU and ME, 250 MI may be lettered after.

panels.composition: Chloe holding the map. Not saying anything for a panel. Then folding it into the thick envelope with the acceptance letter.

characters.pose: folding the map into the envelope

image.prompt: a teenage girl carefully folding a hand-drawn map into a thick acceptance envelope, a boy beside her, school newsroom

notes: The map of a city he'll never live in. She keeps it. The strip will remember the envelope in 2021.
